name: mixed — architectural sheets, a 3D model, and two LiDAR scans in one scene
comment: The closing scene of the point-cloud series, and the only one that exercises BOTH load paths at once. Drawing sheets and floor_model are meshes + polylines: they go through the whole-file prost path (fetch, decode, walk into the shared tables, upload). The two scans are cloud-only .pb files: they go through the Range-streaming path and never become kernel objects at all. The order below deliberately INTERLEAVES them - sheet, scan, sheets, scan, model - so the two paths take turns and nothing is allowed to depend on running first or last. Sheets are ~2-5 m across and sit in a row at y=-30000; each scan spans about 72 m, so they are spaced 90 m apart along x. Press F: the fit must frame ALL of it, which is the thing that was broken when a streamed cloud's box was the only one the scene remembered.
